tools.name: compress_file_from_url
tools.description: Download a file from a public URL, compress it on micompress.com and return a download link to the smaller file (valid 24 hours) with the size before and after. Works for images (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, HEIC, RAW…), PDF, video, audio, Office documents, EPUB and archives. Accepts direct links and Google

tools.name: get_compression_result
tools.description: Get the result of a compression started by compress_file_from_url, by the job_id it returned (kept for 2 hours). Use it when that call reported the job as still processing; returns the download link once it is done.

tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: List the file extensions MiCompress can compress, grouped by category, with the size limit for this connection.
